Global Markets Mixed Amid Earnings Data and Oil Prices

Global stock markets showed mixed performance as investors awaited US earnings data, while oil prices remained elevated. European stocks, specifically the STOXX 600, closed higher, with bank shares helping to offset the impact of oil price increases. In the US, UnitedHealth shares exhibited unusual behavior ahead of their earnings report.
